page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server instance belonging to the ecs.gn5 family. It is equipped with 8 dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 vCPUs operating at 2.5 GHz, 60.0 GB of system memory, and a bundled 472 GB local SSD. Acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. The instance runs on the KVM hypervisor and supports a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear contrast between CPU and GPU capabilities. The dedicated Intel Xeon CPU exhibits weak performance, with stress-ng single-core scoring in the bottom 10% and multi-core in the bottom 25%. Passmark CPU and database scores also fall into the average to weak categories. However, the integrated NVIDIA P100 GPU delivers top-tier performance in LLM inference benchmarks. Prompt processing for a 7B model reaches 316.69 tokens per second, and text generation achieves 42.77 tokens per second, both placing in the top 10%.

This instance offers a qualitative cost-efficiency advantage for legacy GPU-accelerated workloads, providing dedicated GPU resources and local SSD storage without the premium associated with newer GPU architectures. The primary tradeoff is the lower CPU and memory bandwidth performance, which limits its suitability for CPU-heavy processing. It is best suited for medium-scale LLM inference, GPU-accelerated machine learning tasks, and static web serving.
